Dehydrated Onion Chopped Manufacturer: Dehydrated Onion Chopped for Wholesale and Export

Dehydrated onion chopped is fresh onion that has been cut into small pieces and dried, so it keeps for months and goes straight into the pot or the mixer. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated onion chopped manufacturer supplying food-grade chopped onion to food processors, seasoning companies, restaurants, QSRs, importers, distributors and private label brands. The onions are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, then cleaned, cut, dehydrated, sieved, inspected and packed in moisture-resistant food-grade packaging. As a dehydrated onion chopped supplier and dehydrated onion chopped exporter from India, we handle bulk, wholesale, OEM and custom packaging orders for buyers at home and abroad.

Chopped dried onion does the job of fresh onion in a shelf-stable form. It saves peeling, cutting, labour, storage space and preparation waste, and it gives a dependable onion aroma and savoury flavour across recipes. Buyers can ask for our standard specification, private label packing, export documentation support and quotations based on destination, volume, packaging and application.

Product Overview

Dehydrated Onion Chopped is made by drying prepared onion pieces under controlled conditions. The result is a light, stable ingredient that can go directly into dry formulations or be soaked before cooking. It suits manufacturers who need bulk dehydrated onion chopped supplier support, wholesale dehydrated chopped onion and steady supply for industrial food production.

  • Product: Dehydrated Onion Chopped
  • Raw material: Selected edible onion bulbs
  • Cut: Chopped pieces
  • Moisture: Not more than 8%
  • Shelf life: 12 months in sealed packaging
  • Processing: Cleaning, trimming, chopping, dehydration, sieving, inspection and packing
  • Origin: India

Manufacturing and Processing

Raw onions are chosen for maturity, cleanliness, colour, aroma and suitability for drying. They are cleaned and trimmed, then cut into controlled chopped pieces. Drying uses controlled hot-air systems that bring the moisture down while keeping the onion flavour and a useful bite. We may adjust processing for the onion variety, the final moisture target and the buyer's application.

After drying, the pieces are cooled, sieved and inspected for uniformity. Foreign material controls, batch identification, handling procedures and moisture checks apply throughout production. Customers can send a product specification, destination-country requirements or an application brief for technical review before commercial production.

Quality and Food Safety

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business. We follow documented hygiene practices, raw material selection procedures, batch traceability, quality inspection, moisture control and standard operating procedures. Specifications and documents are reviewed against the buyer's market and application. We do not claim certifications beyond our FSSAI licence and IEC registration, so please confirm any document needs before placing an order.

Our routine checks cover visual appearance, aroma, moisture, foreign matter and cut-size consistency. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Samples and a document package can be discussed during quotation.

Typical Specifications

  • Mesh or cut size: Chopped pieces, as described on the product specification sheet
  • Moisture: Not more than 8%
  • Purity: Single-ingredient onion, cleaned and sorted to the agreed specification
  • Appearance: Cream to pale yellow dried onion pieces, depending on raw material
  • Flavour: Typical sweet, savoury, mildly pungent onion flavour
  • Additives: No added colour or flavour unless specifically requested and agreed
  • Foreign matter: Controlled according to the agreed product specification
  • Packaging: Food-grade, moisture-resistant, tamper-evident and export-suitable options

Applications

Dehydrated chopped onion is easy to add to dry mixes, cooked foods, sauces, snacks and seasonings. It can go directly into products that have enough moisture, or be soaked in water first. Rehydration ratio and soaking time depend on the recipe, so industrial users should check performance in their own formulation.

  • Soup, gravy, sauce and ready-to-cook mixes
  • Seasoning blends, instant noodle masala and spice mixes
  • Snack foods, namkeen, savoury bakery products and crackers
  • Burgers, patties, meat alternatives and prepared foods
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, cloud kitchen and QSR recipes
  • Pickles, chutneys, dips, marinades and convenience foods

Buyer Value

  • Longer storage life than fresh onion when kept in suitable conditions
  • Less preparation labour, trimming loss and kitchen handling
  • Less reliance on daily fresh onion buying and cold storage
  • Consistent chopped format for repeatable industrial recipes
  • Lower freight weight and simpler dry-goods inventory
  • Flexible bulk, retail, export, OEM and private label supply

Packaging and Shelf Life

Packaging is chosen to suit order volume, market, handling system and brand. Standard options are 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg packs. Bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, custom printed packaging, private label packaging and export packaging can also be arranged. The packaging protects the product from humidity, contamination, light and physical damage in storage and transport.

Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when unopened and stored as recommended. Keep the product in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and strong odours. Each shipment can be labelled with the product name, batch number, manufacturing date, best-before information, net weight, storage instructions and other agreed details.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotes

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated onion chopped manufacturer supply? The MOQ is 5 Kg. That makes it easy to test the product in your own recipes before moving to bulk. Custom formulations, printed packaging and OEM projects may need larger quantities. Buying in bulk usually brings a better price and steadier supply.

Lead time depends on stock, raw material buying, order quantity, packaging, documents and destination requirements. Standard products can usually be planned faster than custom or private label orders, and we confirm timing in each quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your estimated quantity, packaging preference, destination country, application, label needs and any quality specification. Tradenest Naturals will review feasibility and reply with a commercial offer, the product specification sheet and shipment terms.

Export and Private Label Support

As a dehydrated chopped onion manufacturer India and dehydrated chopped onion exporter India, Tradenest Naturals works with importers, distributors, food brands and contract manufacturers on export orders. We review each order for destination-country requirements, labelling, packaging, traceability, documents and transport. OEM and private label programmes can include custom pack sizes, artwork coordination, agreed specifications and repeat supply that grows with you.

If you are looking for a dependable dehydrated onion chopped exporter, bulk dehydrated onion chopped supplier or food-grade ingredient partner, contact Tradenest Naturals with your target specification and buying plan. Our team will help you find a practical format for your recipe, supply chain and market.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated chopped onion?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Bulk, OEM and private label orders can be discussed for larger or repeat volumes.

Which cut sizes are available?

We supply a standard chopped cut, described on the product specification sheet. If you need a finer form, ask about our onion granules or onion powder.

What is dehydrated chopped onion used for?

It is used in soup, gravy, sauce and ready-to-cook mixes, seasoning blends and instant noodle masala, snacks and namkeen, burgers and patties, pickles and chutneys, and in restaurant, hotel, catering and QSR recipes.

What packaging options do you offer?

The product can be packed in bulk bags or HDPE containers, including 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg packs, and private label packs can be arranged on request.

How can I request a sample or quote?

Send your estimated quantity, packaging preference, destination country and application on WhatsApp. Samples are available on request, and we confirm dispatch timing in the quotation.
